highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.158.0 update improves filtered image and glyph correctness without changing managed APIs.
highlights_body: Skia m158 fixes keep antialiased sampling inside image subsets and make image-filter cache equality consistent with hashing.

bullets.detail: Image filters and Ganesh draws retain subset clamping when padding cannot contain AA or MSAA extrapolation. Minified, strongly skewed and transparent-border draws avoid sampling unrelated pixels outside logical texture bounds.
Cache-key equality now follows the same bytewise representation as hashing, accounting for signed zero, matrix type metadata and subnormal values so lookups and LRU eviction agree.

bullets.lead: Respect regenerated glyph formats and layout
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered text handles font-scaler reloads whose paths, formats or bounds change. It avoids stale-path rasterization, sub-byte buffer overwrites and format assertions, clears incompatible masks, and correctly copies clipped embossed-mask planes.
